name: CompuServe Pacific
summary: CompuServe's Australian service, operated as 'CompuServe Pacific' by Fujitsu Australia Ltd; dial-in nodes from ~1991; phased out after AOL's 1998 global acquisition of CompuServe, shut down in the early 2000s (ACN 001 011 427).

events.details: CompuServe Pacific offered dial-in access in Australia, run by Fujitsu Australia Ltd; the earliest Wayback capture of compuserve.com.au (25 Dec 1996) carries the 'CompuServe Pacific' / 'Fujitsu Australia Ltd' branding. The ~1991 start predates the archive and is approximate.

Australian service phased out and shut down following AOL's 1998 global acquisition of CompuServe; compuserve.com.au later redirected to the global compuserve.com. Service announced closed effective 31 Aug 2007; homepage (unchanged frameset) was still being served 1 Sep 2007 and redirects to global CompuServe by 2013-14 — 2007 is exact.

refs.label: Fujitsu Australia-operated franchise; also mirrored on Alfawiki/wiki34
Homepage still live 1 Sep 2007, days after the announced closure date
By Jan 2014 the AU domain redirected to the global CompuServe site
